featured.claimText: A 95% per-step success rate sounds strong. Compounded over a 30-step episode it is not. Move the sliders to see how small per-step errors erode end-to-end reliability; the frontier essays develop the argument.
featured.describedByText: At 95.0 percent per-step success, episode success is 21.5% at 30 steps and 0.6% at the 100-step end of the plotted range, crossing 50 percent at 14 steps as the per-step odds compound over the episode length.
